def max_sub(nums):
    best = nums[0]
    cur = 0
    for n in nums:
        cur = max(n, cur + n)
        best = max(best, cur)

def josephus(n, k):
    people = list(range(1, n + 1))
    idx = 0
    while len(people) > 1:
        idx = (idx + k - 1) % len(people)
        people.pop(idx)
    return people[0]

questions.solution:
def josephus(n, k):
    people = list(range(1, n + 1))
    idx = 0
    while len(people) > 1:
        idx = (idx + k - 1) % len(people)
        people.pop(idx)
    return people[0]

print(f"Survivor: {josephus(6, 3)}")

questions.description: 函数返回分组异或结果。
函数返回可形成最大数。
questions.code_template:
def largest_number(nums):
    from functools import cmp_to_key
    strs = [str(n) for n in nums]
    strs.sort(key=cmp_to_key(lambda a, b: -1 if a + b > b + a else 1))
    result = "".join(strs)
    return "0" if result[0] == "0" else result

print(___)
questions.solution:
def largest_number(nums):
    from functools import cmp_to_key
    strs = [str(n) for n in nums]
    strs.sort(key=cmp_to_key(lambda a, b: -1 if a + b > b + a else 1))
    result = "".join(strs)
    return "0" if result[0] == "0" else result

print(largest_number([3, 30, 34, 5, 9]))
